objective: Measure the independent causal contribution of omitting exact empty absent-fact placeholders to strict v4 schema recovery on the frozen external-holdout raw responses.

intervention.name: omit_exact_empty_absent_fact_placeholders
intervention.operation: Remove the eligible fact mention while preserving the relative order and exact values of every noneligible fact mention and every clause atom.
forbidden_changes: editing or filling any fact value
dropping a partially populated or otherwise invalid fact
loading or applying the long evidence span oracle
using gold, model, network, parser, or canonicalizer output

criteria: Exactly 27 eligible placeholders are removed from exactly the four registered targets.
All four target cases change from strict-schema invalid to strict-schema valid.
The Atira negative control remains strict-schema invalid with the same ten long-source diagnostics and is byte-identical.
Every clause atom and every noneligible fact mention remains byte-identical and in order.
Reinserting the audited removed records at their original indexes reconstructs the frozen raw exactly.
The frozen raw input hash is identical before and after evaluation.
No other oracle output, model, network, parser, or canonicalizer is used.
acceptance_gate.falsification: Reject this mechanism as independently sufficient for its four targets if any target remains invalid, any noneligible value changes, or any control changes.
acceptance_gate.interpretation_limit: Even full support explains only the four empty-placeholder cases. It cannot repair Atira and does not establish unseen-data generalization.

next_allowed_action: Implement and freeze only the omission oracle runner, then execute it once from the frozen external raw.
